name: Click to Chat & Order
author: Keral Patel

sections.description:
Click to Chat & Order adds a clean, fast WhatsApp chat button to your site. Visitors tap it, their WhatsApp opens with a pre-filled message ready for you. No WhatsApp Business API, no Meta verification, no monthly fees — just paste your number and go.

Features

  • Floating button (bottom-left or bottom-right)
  • Custom button label, colour and pre-filled greeting
  • [bswco_button] shortcode for inline buttons anywhere
  • Per-device control (mobile / desktop)
  • Hide on specific pages by ID
  • Configurable show-delay to prevent layout shift on slow connections
  • Accessible: ARIA labels, keyboard focusable, reduced-motion aware
  • No external requests, no tracking, no bloat — under 6 KB total

How it works

The plugin uses WhatsApp’s standard wa.me/ click-to-chat links. There is no API key, no account linking, no per-message cost. Works with the free WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business app on the merchant’s phone.

Pro version

For multi-agent support, schedules, page-level display rules, WooCommerce “Order on WhatsApp” + Cart-to-WhatsApp, click analytics, additional themes and priority support, check out Click to Chat & Order Pro by BlueSoftWeb.

Privacy

This plugin makes zero external requests and stores no visitor data. The only data saved is the settings you enter in the admin screen.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install through Plugins → Add New and upload the .zip.
  2. Activate.
  3. Go to Settings → Click to Chat and paste your WhatsApp number in international format (digits only, no plus sign).
  4. Save. The button appears site-wide.
sections.faq:
Do I need the WhatsApp Business API?

No. The plugin uses standard click-to-chat links. The WhatsApp Business API is only required for automated outbound messages or chatbots, neither of which this plugin needs.

What number format do I use?

International format with country code, digits only, no leading plus. Example: 447900123456 for a UK number, 14155551234 for a US number.

Will the button slow my site down?

No. Total payload is under 6 KB, no external requests are made and the button is loaded with a configurable delay to avoid Cumulative Layout Shift on slow connections.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

The Free version adds a site-wide button only. The Pro version adds dedicated “Order on WhatsApp” buttons on product pages, variation-aware messages and a cart-to-WhatsApp checkout flow.

Is my visitor data tracked?

No. The Free plugin makes zero external requests and stores no visitor data.
